name: Ragefire Chasm
note: The Horde's first dungeon, beneath Orgrimmar. Quick XP, quick gear.

name: Wailing Caverns
note: A druidic maze in the Barrens. Long walk, strong early drops.

name: The Deadmines
note: Defias hideout under Westfall — the Alliance's first real dungeon.

name: Shadowfang Keep
note: Worgen fortress in Silverpine. Excellent early caster loot.

name: Blackfathom Deeps
note: Twilight's Hammer cult in Ashenvale. Bring water breathing.

name: The Stockade
note: Stormwind's prison riot. Fast, dense pulls, easy group finder.

name: Gnomeregan
note: Radiation and troggs. Skippable, but the caster loot is real.

name: Razorfen Kraul
note: Quillboar tunnels in the Barrens. Compact and efficient.

name: Scarlet Monastery
note: Four wings. The fastest XP in the 30s if your group can chain pulls.

name: Uldaman
note: Titan ruins in the Badlands. Long, but the quest rewards are worth it.

name: Zul'Farrak
note: Desert troll city with the famous stairs event. Great XP per hour.

name: Maraudon
note: Centaur princess and strong caster loot. The princess run is a staple.

name: The Temple of Atal'Hakkar
note: The Sunken Temple. Class quests and a classic 'one more boss' layout.

name: Blackrock Depths
note: The mega-dungeon. BRD runs define pre-raid gearing — and the Ironfoe chase.

name: Lower Blackrock Spire
note: First half of the Spire. Fast runs, solid pre-raid drops.

name: Upper Blackrock Spire
note: Dal'Rend, Rend Blackhand, and the last pre-raid wall before Molten Core.

name: Dire Maul
note: Three wings — east, west, north. Tribute runs are the classic money maker.

name: Stratholme
note: Undead city. Baron runs for the mount; living side for quests.

name: Scholomance
note: Necromancer school. Class books and caster loot.

name: Molten Core
note: The first raid tier. Fire resistance gear and attunement drama.

name: Onyxia's Lair
note: One boss, one legendary head. The classic raid night warm-up.

name: Blackwing Lair
note: Nefarian's lair. Suppression rooms and the Razorgore dance.

name: Zul'Gurub
note: 20-man troll raid with the Hakkar fight and reputation rewards.

name: Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj
note: The 20-man AQ raid. Fast, tuned for alt-friendly gearing.

name: Temple of Ahn'Qiraj
note: The 40-man AQ raid. C'Thun is the wall that defines the tier.

name: Naxxramas
note: The final Classic raid. Four wings, Kel'Thuzad, and the hardest gear check.
